The '''Alliance Database''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] intelligence dossier on personnel affiliated with both the Rebellion and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
